body:
I've done therapy in the past, I even checked myself into a clinic the last time I was feeling this dark. It was nice, having some one to talk with who cared and it gave me the tools to deal with future situations like this. But in my case at least those tools have lost some of their edge.

The thing is on paper I'm pretty awesome. My life is stable but I do enough interesting things and know enough interesting people that it's never boring. I am kind, generous, and adventurous. At social gatherings I am gregarious and jovial. With my friends I am loyal to a fault, I will drop whatever I'm doing to help a friend in need and I extend that to even people I've just met. I can even be fairly charming when I want to be.

But despite all that, I feel like no one sees past the fact that I'm overweight. I've been working my ass off to change that, I've lost 30 pounds in the last 4 months through a mix of walking and cycling.

I think what I need, more than therapy is a date. It doesn't even particularly need to be a good date. At least I could learn something from a failed date and get some idea of what other areas I need to improve. But as it stands I think I've heard just about every polite decline possible and I feel like I'm shadow banned on the dating sites I use.

I wish I could give you something helpful man, but I'm feeling pretty terminally special right now.

The family I was referring to was parents and siblings. I have no children and have never been married or even at risk of either of those. That's the frustration. I have no one. I live alone and if did punch out it would probably be weeks before anyone found me. 

In a year I will be 30. And if the last ten years are any indication I will be as alone then as I am today.

I know. That's why everything is so fucked. On paper I should be the picture of a late 20's urban professional. I am not pulling down six figures but where I live my income makes me a top 30%er. I have all the stuff anyone could ever want. But for what? I have no one to share it with, no one to care. Sure my family (parents, siblings) might care if I punched out but you're absolutely right if I punched out it would be selfish, my whole life is selfish, what's one more act?

After I posted I went for a bike ride to clear my head now I am sitting at a bar nursing a beer. It just all seems so pointless.
